woods 1.title: Woods
woods 1.text:
Cobby: [We are going back to Ant Hill. The priest will send people after us, so we must hurry.]

Cobby: [If you get badly wounded... I may have to leave you behind. I'm sorry, but Ant Hill depends on us. I expect you to do the same. I hope you'd understand. Let's move.]

You and Cobby walk all day long.

---

Cobby: [It's been pretty quiet so far, but let's be extra alert tonight. I'll take the first watch like usual. Get some sleep.]

woods 3.title: Woods
woods 3.text:
You sleep for what feels like a minute until Cobby wakes you up to switch post.

You are now on watch.
You sit there, looking up at the glittering night sky, thinking about this adventure of your lifetime.
You recall all those fights you had, about all the monsters that you have slain... and you've never hunted anything bigger than an ant before this journey.

woods 4.title: Woods
woods 4.text: You hear something in the dark. A soft voice, someone whispering...

opt.text: Alert Cobby and prepare to fight

woods 4 2.title: Woods
woods 4 2.text:
You try to make out the words.

You listen carefully...

Suddenly, arrows fly from various directions.

Cobby: [We're under attack! ARGHHH!]

Cobby is hit by an arrow and collapses.

woods 5.title: Woods
woods 5.text: Cobby: [Looks like they've caught up to us... I thought this through wrong. We should move in the dark and rest when it's bright. Let's continue moving. We'll rest tomorrow morning.]

field 1.title: Field
field 1.text:
You reach a clearing of grassy fields where you had encountered the blue beetle two days ago.

Cobby: [It is getting bright. If we rest here, we'll have sight of anyone approaching us. I'll take the first watch..]

You lie down and fall asleep in seconds. It feels like you haven't slept for days...

field 2.title: Field
field 2.text:
It is night.
You wake Cobby up.

Cobby: [Ooh... just 5 more minutes.]

Cobby: [Alright... ok. It's night already, huh? I guess I should be thankful that there were no more ambushes.]

Cobby: [We're going to run out of food today. Wish we had time to resupply at Stone Henge before all that happened...]

field hunt.title: Field
field hunt.text:
You and Cobby go out to the fields looking for something to hunt for food.

You spot something.

field done.title: River side
field done.text:
You continue on for 2 days.

You pass through the goldenrod forest and the woods, and arrive back at the river.

Cobby: [We're back here again. Things have been pretty quiet so far. I just... Never mind. I don't see our old raft here. Let's set up camp here and I'll start building a raft. You go and get me some sturdy wood, like last time.]

river hunt.title: River side
river hunt.text:
You go out to the woods looking for sturdy wood.

You spot something.

river done.title: River side
river done.text:
You and Cobby jump on the fresh made raft and start rowing back towards Ant Hill.

Cobby seems worried, and is completely lost in thought.

You row back in complete silence.

river ask concern.title: River side
river ask concern.text: Cobby: [Do you think... no, that can't be. Never mind.]

river ask cheese.title: River side
river ask cheese.text: Cobby: [Honestly, Cheese would have slowed us down. He's not fit to travel for so long. I feel kind of guilty to burden Pemmi with him.]

river crossed.title: River side
river crossed.text:
Cobby: [There is no time to waste. Let's go straight to Ant Hill. We should arrive by noon.]

You travel for the entire night and morning without rest.
The landscapes become more and more familiar as you travel.

The sun is now directly over your head, and the Ant Hill's mound is in sight.

ant hill day return.title: Ant Hill
ant hill day return.text:
You reach the clearing beyond the treeline to a open view of Ant Hill.

Cobby: [Everything is as same as ever. It feels like we haven't been here for like a year...]

You enter Ant Hill.
Some of the people on the streets recognize you and Cobby.
They clap and holler, congratulating you for your successful mission.
But many of them notice your gloomy expression and start to gossip in curiosity.

You arrive at the temple.
The priest seems extremely surprised by your presence.
After a brief moment, he talks.

Priest: [I don't know what to say. You made it!!]

Cobby: [No, no. We were kidnapped and given as spider food by the damn Stone Henge priest. They were killing our people... Everyone from Ant Hill that got there must've been kidnapped and put to death. We barely escaped..]

The priest looks nervous.

Priest: [I don't know what to say... But rationally speaking, I can't trust you. No one returns from the Journey...]

Cobby: [You... know about this, don't you?]

Priest: [I'm sorry, You shouldn't have come back.]

Several guards come out from the shadows behind and grab you and Cobby.

opt.to: >encounter>ant hill priest guards>@ant hill expel 1>@ant hill escape 1

ant hill expel 1.title: Ant Hill
ant hill expel 1.text:
You hear Cobby break out of his grabs and make a run for it.

The remaining guards knock you down.
They take away your weapons, then drag you into a hidden, dark tunnel behind the temple, to be locked away...

ant hill expel 2.title: River
ant hill expel 2.text:
You spend what feels like the whole night in the cell.
In pitch black darkness, the guards come in and blindfold and leash you.

They drag you out of the cell, into the streets of Ant Hill, in front of everyone you knew your whole life.

The priest announces your dishonorable retreat from the journey and excommunication from Ant Hill.

The guards continue to drag you toward the woods.

ant hill expel 3.title: River
ant hill expel 3.text:
The guards take you to the river.
They move you on a raft and unbind your shackles.

Guard: [Please don't come back to Ant Hill. We do not wish to kill you.]

They push your raft away from land.

ant hill escape 1.title: Ant Hill Escape
ant hill escape 1.text:
You make a run for it.
You dash through the maze like underground tunnels of Ant Hill and out towards the only exit at the top of the mound.
The guards at the entrance have no clue what's going on, until they hear shouting coming from inside.

Guard: [GET HIM!]

You run out the streets, out towards the woods.
You run towards the river.

The priest hold authority, and he will not let you back in.
Your old life is over.

There is only one place you can go: back to Stone Henge.

ant hill escape 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 2.text:
You continue moving away from Ant Hill, completely exhausted, hungry, and overloaded with emotions.
You arrive at the river where you had set up camp a week ago.

You sit by the dead bonfire and think about what to do.
The priest hold authority, and he will not let you back in to Ant Hill... Your old life is over.
You don't know where Cobby is, and it's probably not a good idea to sit here waiting for him.

The only place that you can think about going to is Stone Henge.
You start building a raft to cross the river once again.

ant hill escape camp.title: River side
ant hill escape camp.text:
You are at camp.
You need to find some sturdy wood to construct a raft.

If you fall here, there won't be anyone to save you.

ant hill escape 3.title: River side
ant hill escape 3.text:
You finish constructing the raft.
You hop on and start rowing.

...

The raft starts shaking.
There is something in the water!

ant hill escape 4-1.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-1.text:
You arrive on the other side of the river, bruised and exhausted.
You climb a tree and rest.

...

???: [Wake up!]

Could it be Cobby? You open your eyes.
It is Lucid, the spellcaster from the spider forest.

Lucid: [I saw your exile from Ant Hill. This must be hard for you... Are you going back to Stone Henge?]

ant hill escape 4-1 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-1 2.text: Lucid: [Ah, very well. I was on my way back to Jericho as well. We may as well accompany each other on the way, since the wildlife here are dangerous to say the least.]

ant hill escape 4-2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-2.text:
You arrive on the other side of the river, bruised and exhausted.
You climb a tree and rest.

...

???: [Wake up!]

Could it be Cobby? You open your eyes.
You see a stranger wearing black leather jacket.
He doesn't look hostile.

Stranger: [Hello friend, my name is Lucid. I am a foreign visitor who stayed in Ant Hill. I saw your excommunication and sneaked out of Ant Hill to follow you.]

opt.text: A foreign visitor in Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 4-2 2.title: River side
ant hill escape 4-2 2.text:
Lucid: [I'm afraid that your priest is hiding some truths from you. Yes, foreigners visit Ant Hill, although very rare.]

Lucid: [I come from a city named Jericho. It is a bit of a journey from here, but maybe we could accompany each other on the way since it's on the same route as Stone Henge.]

ant hill escape 5.title: Woods
ant hill escape 5.text:
Lucid: [Then let us journey on.]

Lucid: [But first of all... I'm guessing you have some questions for me.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-1.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-1.text: Lucid: [I am... a sort of a scout from Jericho. It is my duty to find out how bad things are out here. If you ever get to Jericho, I would tell you more about my job. But I don't think you'd have any use for such knowledge here.]

ant hill escape 6-2.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-2.text: Lucid: [My understanding is that it is your priest's duty to serve the greater good. I know this could be hard for you, but he may not necessarily have bad intentions.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-3.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-3.text: Lucid: [I will accompany you to Stone Henge. But unless you come with me to Jericho, I can't help you.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

ant hill escape 6-4.title: Woods
ant hill escape 6-4.text: Lucid: [Jericho may sound strange for you, since you lived in Ant Hill your whole life. Imagine lots of smooth moving stones. Also, the monsters that you see here are much smaller near Jericho. Nevertheless, Jericho have their own set of problems to deal with.]

opt.text: Why were you at Ant Hill?

stone henge outskirt.title: Stone Henge Outskirts
stone henge outskirt.text:
You lead Lucid to Stone Henge.
There were monster ambushes and food shortages, but nothing that you haven't been through already.

Four days passed, and you are near Stone Henge once again.
It gets dark just as you reach the outskirts.

stone henge outskirt 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 2.text: Lucid: [Here we are. You need some help finding your friends, don't you? Stand still, I will turn you into a small mouse.]

stone henge outskirt 3-1.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 3-1.text:
You turn into a small mouse. Everything is so much bigger!

Lucid: [Be aware, you will not be able to interact with things like you normally would. I'll be staying at the Dolomite Inn.]

stone henge outskirt 3-2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge outskirt 3-2.text:
Lucid: [I don't blame you for not wanting to trust people anymore. But be careful. If you need any help, Know that I'm staying at the Dolomite Inn for a few days.]

Lucid walks away to Stone Henge.
Where will you go?

stone henge caught.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught.text:
You stick to the shadows and try to sneak into Stone Henge.
As soon as you approach the giant stone complex, a glowing orb flies toward you.

Guard: [Intruder!]

You run, but the spell light follows you.
You smack the spell orb away to the ground.
Suddenly, you feel a sharp pain in your leg. You were shot by an arrow!
You collapse.
The guards run toward you.

stone henge caught 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught 2.text:
You barely escape the guards.
Where to now?

opt.text: Sneak into Stone Henge temple again
Sneak into Stone Henge shop again

stone henge caught 3.title: Stone Henge
stone henge caught 3.text:
You crawl back to Lucid.

Lucid: [Oh... You must be careful, the guards seem to know that you are here. You can safely rest and heal here as long as I'm here.]

stone henge sneak.title: Stone Henge
stone henge sneak.text:
You manuever through the streets as a small mouse.
People tend to kill small critters that resemble the larger monsters, so you try to avoid attention as much as possible.
You climb the giant stone bricks and enter the temple in pitch black darkness.
You hear people murmuring.
You listen more carefully. It sounds like the Stone Henge priest quietly talking to his guard...

Priest: [...So, invite the man into the temple tomorrow morning and keep looking for the other one.]

You realize he is talking about you and Lucid.
You stand there, trying to get as much information as possible, but it looks like the conversation has ended.

Just as you try to leave, you see a valuable looking ring on a table nearby.
Without hesitation, you pick it up with your mouth.
Suddenly, the whole room becomes clearer, and a little bit brighter... It seems that the ring allows you to see better in the dark.
You leave the temple and head towards Dolomite Inn.

dolomite inn.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn.text:
You arrive at the inn at the first floor of the large stone complex.
Like most other buildings here, there are no walls and you easily sneak into Lucid's room.

Lucid: [Oh, don't worry about me, they won't harm me. You should worry about yourself, since they know you are here. When the priest invites me over tomorrow, I'll try to get as many clues as possible to the whereabouts of your friends. As for tonight, you can sleep here, away from the ledge. I'll make sure no one enters this room.]

dolomite inn 2.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn 2.text:
You rest.
You dream of flying around Ant Hill annoying people with your mandibles...

...

You awaken to someone talking.

Lucid: [Hey, wake up, today I learned that your friend Cheese was caught and sent to the spider forest.]

Lucid hands you a necklace.

Lucid: [Look, this is my precious necklace that I always wear. It will allow you to turn yourself into a small mouse. If you make it out of the forest, you must give it back to me.]

dolomite inn 3.title: Stone Henge
dolomite inn 3.text: Lucid: [Is it honor? Or too much burden for you? Either way, I respect your choice. Good luck in the den.]

stone henge tribute.title: Stone Henge
stone henge tribute.text:
You wake up.
It looks so familiar... Oh, you are in that Stone Henge spider den. Same room too.

You try to take your bindings off, but it is no use.
You realize that you walked straight into certain death, after avoiding it once with blind luck.
You despair...

stone henge tribute 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge tribute 2.text:
You hear a familiar voice in the darkness.
It is Lucid.

Lucid: [Oh, you are such a lucky person. But your luck will not last if you keep making bad choices like that.]

It is Lucid! he must have followed you here after you were caught by the guards.
Lucid takes your bindings off with a knife.

Lucid: [Come, I've learned that there are others like you in this den. Let us go deeper in... After we kill that spider behind you.]

stone henge search.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search.text:
You try to make your way to the spider forest.
You suddenly realize, that you don't remember how to get there from Stone Henge because you were deeply hypnotized the last time you went there.
You get lost in the woods for some time and somehow make it back to Stone Henge.

You crawl back to the inn.

Lucid: [...Ah, a hot tempered spirit, aren't you? You should rest here one more day and try to get more information about things first. I will be leaving Stone Henge tomorrow, but I will help you as much as I can before then. Stand still.]

Lucid turns you into a small mouse.

Stick to the shadows. Come back when you're feeling tired, the spell has nasty side effects.

stone henge search 2.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search 2.text:
You sneak around Stone Henge, looking for any clues to the whereabouts of Cheese or Pemmi.
You hide in the temple, listen to the guards, listen to rumors at the tavern, etc...

Hours pass.
You come back to Dolomite inn without any valuable information.

Lucid: [Ah, here you are, I was about to congratulate you. I have found Cheese and Pemmi.]

Cheese: [Oh, hey.]

Pemmi: [Oh!! You're back! Where's Cobby? How did it go in Ant Hill? It's a mess here, I'm glad to see you are back.]

Lucid: [Pemmi approached me when I visited the priest today. We had a private conversation and I learned that she is one of your friends.]

Pemmi: [I was laying low, trying to get people to see what's going on... but it's no use. Everyone trusts the priest.]

Cheese: [It's not so bad. Stone Henge has better food. I don't mind living here, honestly.]

Pemmi: [No.. It's not right for us to kill outsiders like that. Also, how do I know if the priest is not killing our own people? We need to stop this. Maybe we could find other victims?]

opt.text: Tell them what happened in Ant Hill

stone henge search 3.title: Stone Henge
stone henge search 3.text:
You tell them all that happened in Ant Hill.
Lucid, Pemmi, and even Cheese listens carefully as you unfold the unbelievable story of betrayal.

Cheese: [I... I knew my dad was a prick, but wow. He kicked me out to die?]

Lucid: [There still could be some possibility that the priest didn't mean to kill all of you.]

Pemmi: [That confirms that these priests are up to no good. I don't know what to do...]

You, Cheese, and Pemmi complain and whine for an hour until before calming down.

Lucid: [All right. I think I have told everyone that I come from Jericho. But I never told you why I am here. So here it goes.]

Lucid: [I don't know how to put this... Frontier settlements are known to sacrifice a few of their citizens every month to the horned spider packs.]

Pemmi: [Frontier settlements? What's that?]

Lucid: [Settlements that are to the south of Jericho are seen as frontiers who live with untamed wildlife. That includes your Ant Hill and Stone Henge.]

Cheese: [... Wait, so Ant Hill, or my dad was sacrificing me to the spiders? What? Why!!]

Lucid: [And... I have found out that there may yet be more to this. If you wish to free more sacrifices like yourselves, we need to go deep into the spider den. There may be others like you, still trapped in there.]

Pemmi: [Well.. We may be helpless with Stone Henge, but at least we could save a few others like us. I'm in.]

Lucid: [I will come with you too. You've been good company for me, and I would like to help.]

Cheese: [I'll... come with, I guess.]

stone henge search 4.title: Stone Henge Woods
stone henge search 4.text:
You leave Stone Henge for the woods where the spider den was located.

Pemmi: [Be sure to remember how we got here, just in case I don't make it.]

You find a giant cave-like hole under a large tree, big enough for four people to enter side by side.
It is the entrance of the den that you escaped through the last time you were here.

Pemmi: [Last time when we were here, there were only one or two spiders. Hopefully it's still that way.]

Lucid: [That means this den isn't one of their main dwellings. Let's get inside.]

You enter the den.

Everyone walks in total silence, in fear of being ambushed by spiders hiding in the dark.

deep spider den.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den.text:
After a few minutes of walking on sticky spider webs, you run into a large cocoon blocking the tunnel.

Pemmi: [Uh oh... I think we've come too deep. Is this like... a mega queen spider's egg or something?]

Lucid: [Looks to me like a doorway for the spiders. There is a hole in the center. And... that is a spider.]

deep spider den 2.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den 2.text:
Your group takes down rest of the spiders.

Lucid: [You all right? Let's take some time to heal.]

After a brief respite, you delve deeper into the den.
Deeper in, you see blue glowshrooms growing on the walls, providing light.

Lucid: [Shh, something's coming this way, let's hide in this room!]

You enter a small room carved into the side of the tunnel.
You hear quiet murmuring, and some bluish lighting draws closer to where you are hiding.

deep spider den 3.title: Horned Spiders' Den
deep spider den 3.text:
Pemmi: [The ferals again! This is where they live!]

Lucid: [Let's be careful. I'm sure there are more of these people.]

Pemmi: [I think we're too late to be careful, we made too much sound. Let's keep going, we're too deep in to turn back, right?]

You continue delving deeper in.
The linear tunnel slowly widens and turns into a cave system, with smooth stone walls and glowshrooms lighting every corner.

Cheese: [They're watching us! left, right... from up there, too!]

Lucid: [And in front of us, too. It seems we have another challenger. Get ready.]

deep spider den 4.title: Feral Cave
deep spider den 4.text:
More and more ferals came out of their den to watch you and your companions in curiosity.

Lucid: [I guess they're not feral after all. This place seems to be their settlement. Also, unlike their warriors, there are few males here. They do not seem too dangerous, let's try to communicate with them.]

You watch Lucid try to communicate with the feral residents, but the residents seem to just watch him with caution.

Pemmi: [Well, we can't communicate with them, they aren't enthusiastic about us, and this place is like a bug nest... I think we should just leave them be. Let's go back.]

Stranger: [Hey!]

Your group turns to find an unusually tanned woman among the crowd.

Stranger: [Thank Gaia, get me out of here!]

Lucid: [...She's speaking our language!]

Stranger: [My name is Sugar. I come from Ant Hill. I was kidnapped here a month ago. I was starting to wonder if I was stuck in this shithole forever.]

Lucid: [I see. Don't worry, we'll get you out of here. But first, my friends and I need a place to eat and rest. We're pretty exhaust from our journey here.]

---

You find a place in the corner away from the eyes of the residents and share your experiences with Sugar.

Sugar: [..So both of those damn priests are up to no good? No fucking surprise. I never trusted that prick in Ant Hill.]

Cheese: [Yea, he's a prick.]

Sugar: [You are the priest's son, Cheese, right? He sent you to die too? Fucking hell.]

Lucid: [Are there more abducted people like you here?]

Sugar: [No... These barbarians eat them. They only saved me because I convinced them that I could craft weapons and cook meat for them.]

Pemmi: [So you cooked the other people here?]

Sugar: [What am I gonna do, baby, it's be cooked or start cooking.]

Lucid: [Well. Enough talk. If you are the only abducted outsider here, our work is done. We will leave the ferals alone and get back to Stone Henge.]

Sugar: [I don't think so. If you're all that's here, then I don't see any chance of us making it out of here.]

Lucid: [What do you mean?]

Sugar: [The spiders... they are out there. I don't know how you got in here, but they won't let us leave.]

Lucid: [We know how to fight. If we move as stealthy as possible, we can make it out. But for the meantime, do you know a safe place to rest and heal? We are a bit exhausted.]

Sugar: [I hope you really know what you're doing then... Those spiders are no joke. Follow me, I know a place we can stay.]
